briefdescription.para: Sends the ONFI Block Erase command to the flash.

briefdescription.para: Writes the spare bytes of a page.

detaileddescription.para: Sends the ONFI Program Page command for the spare area. In HW ECC mode, writes only the free spare bytes before and after the ECC code.

listitem.para: XST_FAILURE if no free spare bytes are available in HW ECC mode or the data transfer fails.

briefdescription.para: Reads the spare bytes of a page from the flash.

listitem.para: XST_FAILURE if the data transfer times out.

briefdescription.para: Changes the data interface and timing mode.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful or if the flash is already in the requested mode.
XST_FAILURE if the interface or timing mode is not valid, a flash command fails, or the timing mode read back from the flash does not match.

briefdescription.para: Reads the Bad Block Table (BBT) or creates it when absent.

detaileddescription.para: Reads the BBT of each target if present in flash. If not, scans the flash for factory marked bad blocks, creates a BBT, writes the primary and mirror BBT into the flash and marks the BBT blocks as reserved.
